newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates see-saw, end down on OMO.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates see-saw, end down on OMO.

text.p: Pakistan money rates swung widely on Thursday before ending lower on uncertainty about the liquidity status prompted by an open market operation (OMO) by the State (central) Bank of Pakistan, dealers said.
Overnights fluctuated, with early offers at 18-19 percent and bids at 12-14 percent. Some trades were done at 13-14 percent before the central bank entered the market, he said.

The SBP accepted 10-11 billion rupees at a cut-off yield of 17.45 percent, pushing overnights up to 19-19.75 percent at which most of the day's trades took place. The market eased near the end, with final trades done at seven to eight percent.
